changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 1.0.86[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]PunchPlay.tv is now the fourth tracking service[/COLOR]
-PunchPlay joins Trakt, SIMKL and MDBList, and like them it stands on its own: nothing it does depends on having any of the other three switched on.
-Sign in from Settings > PunchPlay with a code and a QR, the same way the other services work. The QR comes from PunchPlay itself rather than an outside generator, so the sign-in code never leaves the device on its way to somebody else's server.
-The add-on is registered with PunchPlay as a public client. It carries an application ID and no secret, because a secret inside a downloadable add-on is not a secret.
[COLOR fffdb515]Live scrobbling, through every stage of playback[/COLOR]
-PunchPlay accepts five playback events where the other services accept three, and all five are reported: the start, a heartbeat while the film runs, a real pause, a real resume, and the stop.
-Pausing on the sofa shows as paused on the site, and picking it up again shows as watching. The heartbeat reports progress rather than a pause, so the account does not sit there reading as paused for the whole film.
-Whether something counts as watched is decided by PunchPlay itself, against a threshold you set in the add-on, so there is one rule in one place.
-If PunchPlay is unreachable, progress is kept on the device and sent when the service comes back, with the time each report originally happened. A network outage no longer costs you your place in a film.
[COLOR fffdb515]Your lists, your history, where you left off[/COLOR]
-A PunchPlay folder appears under Movies and under TV Shows: Watchlist, My Lists, Continue Watching, Community Lists and Open List by ID or URL. Films also get Watch History; shows get Next Episodes and My Calendar.
-Continue Watching reads exact positions and hands them to Kodi as resume points, so a title picked from that menu starts where it stopped.
-Next Episodes answers a different question and comes from a different place: not where you are inside a file, but which episode of a series is up next.
-My Calendar lists upcoming airings for the shows you follow, read straight from PunchPlay rather than rebuilt from elsewhere.
-Community Lists shows what PunchPlay is featuring, no account needed. Each list appears in the menu where most of its titles belong, so a list of shows does not turn up among the films. Open List by ID or URL reaches any other public list.
-Trending and Popular sit directly in the Movies and TV Shows menus, and need no account either.
[COLOR fffdb515]Source list[/COLOR]
-The grey marking the row you are on is lighter, so it stays visible against the paler rows such as CAM. It is worked out by the same colour rule as the rest of the card, not typed into the skin, so both skin sizes stay in step.
